title: The pre-push hook hands guard_push the local ref only, so a push of any local branch to work/<id> on the public home passes the work-branch refusal
goal: hook_pre_push passes guard_push the remote ref of each pushed line too, and a push whose remote ref is under refs/heads/work/ on the public home is refused, whatever the local branch is named

run:
import os,sys,subprocess,tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.path.abspath("_tools"))
import kg_hooks, kbpublic
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); w=os.path.join(d,"w"); p=os.path.join(d,"pub.git"); g=lambda *x: subprocess.run(["git",*x],cwd=w,capture_output=True,text=True)
subprocess.run(["git","init","-q","--bare",p],check=True); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",w],check=True)
g("config","user.email","jan.kowalski@corp.example.com"); g("config","user.name","jan.kowalski"); g("commit","-q","--allow-empty","-m","base"); g("remote","add","pub",p); g("config","kb.publishRemote","pub")
sha=g("rev-parse","HEAD").stdout.strip()
kg_hooks.KB=w
r=kg_hooks.hook_pre_push(["pub",p], f"refs/heads/feature {sha} refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa {'0'*40}\n", lambda *a, **k: 0, lambda: [])
assert r==1, f"a push of refs/heads/feature to refs/heads/work/ST-aaaaaaaa on the public home is not refused (hook returned {r})"

notes: Taken into SP-lwkdljxg 2026-11-09: ST-ugkw5mt3 added the work-branch refusal to guard_push; this bug closes the gap in the hook that feeds it. Touches from referrers guard_push (kg_hooks.py:132, kbpublic.py:1174) plus git.md, which describes the pre-push guard.
